title: Video-as-Weights: Compiling a Video Once into Parametric and Token Memory
abstract: arXiv:2611.28221v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) represent videos as thousands of visual tokens, creating a large key-value cache whose memory grows with video length. At the same time, small VLMs that fit on limited hardware understand video far worse than large models. Existing compression methods shorten visual tokens into a brief prompt to save memory, yet the small model still processes them through fixed weights and cannot close this capability gap.   To address both challenges, we introduce Video-as-Weights (VaW), which compiles a video once without seeing any question into the parametric and token memory of a frozen interpreter VLM. Specifically, a compiler VLM watches the video, and a single weight decoder jointly generates the interpreter's LoRA weights and optional prefix tokens from every compiler layer, enabling both same-model compilation and strong-to-weak transfer across model sizes and depths. translated_title: 视频即权重：将视频一次性编译为参数记忆与令牌记忆
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLM）将视频表示为数千个视觉令牌，形成一个随视频长度增长而不断膨胀的键值缓存。与此同时，能够在有限硬件上运行的小型VLM对视频的理解能力远逊于大型模型。现有的压缩方法将视觉令牌缩短为简短的提示以节省内存，但小模型仍然通过固定权重来处理这些内容，无法弥合这一能力差距。为同时应对这两个挑战，我们提出了Video-as-Weights（VaW），它可以在不查看任何问题的情况下，将视频一次性编译到冻结的解释器VLM的参数与令牌记忆中。具体而言，一个编译器VLM观看视频，由一个单一的权重解码器从编译器的每一层联合生成解释器的LoRA权重和可选的前缀令牌，从而同时支持同模型编译以及跨模型规模与深度的强到弱迁移。在六个视频问答基准上，一个0.8B的int（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出Video-as-Weights方法，无需预先知道问题即可将视频一次性编译为冻结解释器VLM的LoRA权重与前缀令牌记忆，既大幅节省显存，又能通过大模型向小模型的知识迁移提升小模型的视频理解能力。
en_tdlr: Video-as-Weights (VaW) compiles a video once, without seeing any question, into the LoRA weights and prefix tokens of a frozen interpreter VLM, saving memory while bridging the video-understanding gap of small models through strong-to-weak knowledge transfer across model scales.
